info.title: GATEWAY-batchinsertion-Delete Airline Flights Cancel-v2-spec
info.description: The Airline Flights Cancellation API provides a streamlined process for canceling multiple airline flight bookings simultaneously. It enables travel agencies and airlines to efficiently manage flight cancellations in bulk, improving operational efficiency and customer service. This API is particularly useful for businesses handling large volumes of reservations, where quick access to cancellation features is critical. By integrating this API, users can ensure timely cancellations, mitigate costs, and provide better support to travelers seeking modifications to their travel plans.

delete.description: This endpoint allows you to cancel a currently booked flight. Ensure that you have the necessary permissions and that the flight is eligible for cancellation.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to cancel a flight. It requires the relevant details such as flight ID and the cancellation reason to process the cancellation request successfully.

DeleteAirlineFlightsCancelRequest.description: The request body for canceling a flight operation.

DeleteAirlineFlightsCancelResponse_200.title: Flight Cancellation Response

status.description: Indicates whether the cancellation operation was successful.

referenceNumber.description: Unique reference number for the cancellation request.

resultId.description: Identifier for the result of the cancellation operation.

state.description: Current state of the flight after cancellation.

processingTimeMs.description: Time taken to process the cancellation request in milliseconds.

message.description: Message providing additional information about the cancellation.

DeleteAirlineFlightsCancelResponse_200.description: Response schema for the flight cancellation operation.

automated.description: Indicates whether the cancellation was processed automatically.

AuditInfo.description: Details about who created the cancellation request and when.
